text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was able to get plenty of rest 
yesterday. It seems I'd built up more 
fatigue than I realized.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Suzuka-san told me I was fast asleep 
without even putting a blanket over me... 
Ehehe."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And so, I'm completely back on my feet 
now! I'll nail today's training for sure!
